title: 도시재정비 촉진을 위한 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00491:20180209:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Maintenance and Improvement of Urban Areas and Dwelling Conditions for Residents) <No. 491, February 9, 2018>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on February 9, 2018.

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) and (2) Omitted.

(3) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on the Promotion of Urban Renewal shall be amended as follows:

In Article 6, "Article 54 (2) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Maintenance and Improvement of Urban Areas and Dwelling Conditions for Residents" shall be replaced with "Article 69 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Maintenance and Improvement of Urban Areas and Dwelling Conditions for Residents".

(4) and (5) Omitted.

Article 4 Omitted.
